hooks.command: cd "/mnt/raid/eigene Daten/GitHub/Stephan-Lefty/NaturlustTrailGuide" && git fetch --quiet >/dev/null 2>&1; BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); DIRTY=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); AHEAD=$(git rev-list --count origin/$BRANCH..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ -n "$DIRTY" ] || [ "$AHEAD" -gt 0 ]; then printf '{"systemMessage": "Reminder: uncommitted changes or %s unpushed commit(s) in NaturlustTrailGuide - commit and git push before switching computers."}\n' "$AHEAD"; else printf '{"systemMessage": "Everything committed and pushed - the other computer can pull safely."}\n'; fi
